caseNameFull: CRASKA, alias DAVIS v. NEW YORK
attorneys: Appellant pro se., Louis J. Lefkowitz, Attorney General of New York, and Robert E. Fischer, Special Assistant Attorney General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for.writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
